text:
marisol: Quick non-work poll — if you had to adopt one kitchen appliance and give it a name, which would you pick and what would you name it? (bonus: why) :grin:
liam: Air fryer. Name: Crunch Master 3000. Because it makes everything better and slightly dangerous. :sunglasses:
priya: Electric kettle — 'Sir Boils-a-Lot'. Fast, polite, and always ready for tea. :tea:
amanda: Fridge. 'The Vault'. Guard of midnight snacks, keeper of leftovers. :lock:
jake: Microwave. 'Zaptron'. Love-hate relationship. Also it tells me how long to nap by beep pattern. :sleeping:
amelia: Espresso machine — 'Lady Caffeine'. Wakes the whole floor and judges my life choices. ☕️
coffee-bot: (bot) FYI: Adopting appliances requires a signed lease agreement with the kitchenette. Kidding. But please put your name on the milk carton if you borrow it. :robot_face:
priya: ALSO argument for blender 'Smooth Criminal' — it makes smoothies and drama.
liam: Crunch Master 3000 would definitely win office trivia night.
amanda: The Vault has my vote if it comes with a snack-dispensing mechanism.
marisol: Vote tally: Air fryer 1, Kettle 1, Fridge 1, Microwave 1, Espresso 1, Blender 1. Looks like we all just want snacks. New office policy: name your appliance and take responsibility for its feelings. :joy:
